parameters.query:
select cs.category_id, cs.name as subcategoria_nome
from public.custom_subcategories cs
where cs.user_id = $1::uuid
  and lower(unaccent(trim(cs.name))) = lower(unaccent(trim($2)))
order by cs.category_id;
